name: Cinderoon
look: a teardrop cocoon of see-through smouldering ash with glowing zigzag bands and embers, the Coalarva inside curled up with its ruby eyes peering out and its abdomen glowing through
entry: Once it has eaten enough coal, it wraps its soft body in a cocoon of cinders. The ash is thin enough to see the Coalarva curled up inside, and it can burn some of it away to hurl a blast of fire at anything that disturbs it.
